title: Tenant Gatekeeper, Access Ledger, and Stream Sanitizer for Observability
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a tenant-aware middleware 'Gatekeeper' that enforces PII redaction rules and retention policies at the observability ingress point, alongside an immutable Access Ledger service that records just-in-time reveals and operator actions. This ticket covers design, PoC, and initial rollout for traces and log events with minimal latency overhead.
technical_design: Gatekeeper will be a lightweight sidecar/adapter in the ingest path that applies tenant-configured sanitization rules (field-level masking, tokenization, allowlists) and attaches provenance metadata. It will consult a local policy cache backed by the Governance Config Service and fall back to a safe default deny-list. The Access Ledger will be an append-only stream (Kafka topic with compacted keys) that stores action records (actor, scope, justification, timestamp, affected-event-ids, redaction-diff-hash). To avoid extra tail latency, Gatekeeper performs synchronous policy evaluation but asynchronous ledger append with best-effort acknowledgment; critical exposes will have a blocking path when 'just-in-time-reveal' flags are present. KV cache invalidation for policy changes will be pushed via our control-plane pubsub with per-tenant version tags.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag off: deploy Gatekeeper in shadow mode to copy-sanitize and measure overhead (2 weeks). 2) Opt-in tenants: enable enforcement for pilot tenants with low traffic and SRE support (2 weeks). 3) Gradual ramp: increase tenant coverage with automated health checks and latency SLO alarms (4 weeks). 4) Global enforcement: flip default and monitor metrics for 72h before deprecating old ingest path.
acceptance_criteria: - Gatekeeper must redact configured sensitive fields for 100% of sampled events for pilot tenants. - End-to-end p95 ingest latency increase <= 8ms in shadow mode and <= 15ms in enforced mode. - Access Ledger entries for reveal requests are searchable by tenant and immutable. - No data loss during policy updates; policy versions must apply consistently within 30s across ingestion nodes.
test_plan: - Unit tests for policy parsing, mask/tokenize libraries.
test_plan_steps: Integration test: simulate tenant policy change and verify cache invalidation across 3 nodes
Load test: 10k events/s with mixed trace/log payloads to measure p50/p95/p99 latency impact
Security test: attempt to inject PII via nested fields and ensure Gatekeeper catches masked paths
metrics_and_alerting: - Ingest latency p50/p95/p99 per tenant before/after Gatekeeper. - Sanitization failure rate (should be 0). - Access Ledger append failures and lag. - Policy sync lag distribution. Alerts: sanitization_failure_rate > 0.1% sustained for 5m; policy_sync_lag > 60s.
runbooks_and_playbooks: Playbook: Revoke erroneous policy rollout and rollback steps
Runbook: Access Ledger corruption detection and recovery
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Added latency on ingest; Mitigation: shadow mode, optimized masking libs, native kernels for common masks
Risk: Ledger storage growth; Mitigation: TTLs, compaction, and hashed redaction diffs instead of full payloads
Risk: Policy drift between nodes; Mitigation: signed policy versions and push-based invalidation with health-check gating
security_considerations: Ledger entries contain justification and actor metadata and must be encrypted at rest with tenant-scoped keys. Access to ledger reads is governed by RBAC; operators require JIT approval and audit logging. Gatekeeper must not log raw PII to stdout or metrics; any telemetry must be pre-scrubbed.
privacy_compliance_notes: Support per-tenant retention windows configurable via Governance UI. Implement a 'soft erase' flow that replaces historical PII with deterministic pseudonyms while preserving traceability via redaction-diff-hash for auditability.
implementation_notes: - Leverage existing tracing hooks in the ingestion service; add Gatekeeper as a middleware layer. - Reuse the Governance Config Service for policy storage. - Use our existing kafka-cluster for ledger topic with compaction and server-side encryption enabled. - Provide SDKs for policy authors with JSONPath expressions and type hints.
